Trading volume is also subdued at 0.43x the 5-day average, hindering directional confirmation.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,668,000) above SMA5 ($1,570,400), below SMA20 ($1,792,550), and below SMA50 ($2,152,046).
· Below SMA100 ($1,702,468), above SMA200 ($1,192,571) — indicating weakening medium-to-long term trend strength.
· 52-week position (48.6%) — located in the historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.2 → 44.5) — attempting to exit oversold, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-60608.8952 → -8714.4488) — improvement confirmed, weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $1,792,550) — band width is wide at 51.43%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at $1,246,000 — based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance at $1,995,000 — potential for uptrend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — sideways range, neither Higher Low nor Lower High confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.43x) — subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — wait-and-see until directional confirmation.
